children.text: Participants
ThinkByte: Anupam Gevariya, Yash Mori, Dharmi Patel
Key Takeaways
Yash Mori and Anupam, both AI engineers at Thinkbulk, introduced themselves and mentioned that the meeting was to get to know the team members.
Team members were advised to check their emails and calendars regularly for meeting invitations, including a tech stand-up meeting scheduled at 12:30 or 2 PM.
New team members were instructed to set up their GitHub accounts and familiarize themselves with Git and Docker, with a document provided for guidance.
The team recently completed a dementia care app project, which included developing small games integrated into the application.
The new member will initially work on various tasks before being assigned a specific role, with a focus on learning GitHub and web scraping libraries.
Yash Mori introduced himself and Anupam as AI engineers at Thinkbulk, and mentioned that the meeting was to get to know the team members.
Team members were advised to check their emails and calendars regularly for meeting invitations and to set up their laptops with necessary IDs for tasks.
The team was encouraged to set up a Github account and familiarize themselves with Git, Docker, and other tools, with a document provided for guidance.
A tech delivery meeting is scheduled on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Fridays at 1:30 PM to discuss tasks, blockers, and new findings.
The team is working on a lead generation project and a dementia care app, with plans to start a new platform project soon.
Background
Explained that for a month, multiple tasks would be assigned that were not specific to any particular subject.
The prospect is a tech intern working on the front-end.
Currently in the 3rd year of college and will enter the 4th year soon.
Learning Redux library and familiar with React, HTML, CSS, Python, Pandas, Matplotlib, and web scraping.
Team Collaboration and Meetings
New members need to introduce themselves effectively, understand team dynamics, requiring them to participate actively in scheduled meetings.
Regular meetings scheduled for team collaboration, progress updates, specifically tech delivery meetings held Monday, Tuesday, Friday at 1:30 PM.
New members should attend scheduled meetings for introductions, updates, ensuring they're integrated into team discussions, project updates.
Ensuring new members receive meeting invites and are aware of schedules can be challenging, necessitating regular communication checks.
Importance placed on regular emails, calendar checks for meeting invitations, ensuring new members are kept in loop, can participate in all relevant discussions.
Meetings serve as platform for discussing progress, addressing blockers, sharing new findings among team members.
Onboarding New Members
Lack of familiarity with team members due to different schedules, making it challenging for new members to meet everyone at once.
Team members encouraged to regularly check emails, calendars for meeting invites, ensuring they stay informed about scheduled meetings and updates.
New members encouraged to set up GitHub accounts with company email addresses, familiarize themselves with Git, Docker, version control practices.
Introduction and orientation of new team members, focusing on interns joining the company to integrate them into the team and familiarize them with company workflows and projects.
New interns will begin with general tasks for a month, allowing them to understand the company's needs and workflows, before transitioning to specific roles based on skills and project requirements.
New members require guidance on using GitHub and setting up necessary tools efficiently, lacking initial familiarity with company protocols and tools.
Team Meetings and Communication
Regular team meetings scheduled for updates, introductions, discussions on tasks, blockers, new findings. Meetings include tech stand-ups and tech delivery meetings.
New intern to attend scheduled meetings, check calendar and emails for invites, and actively participate in meetings for collaborative learning and integration.
Team Introductions and Roles
Not all team members were available for introduction during initial meeting.
Team members will be introduced during future meetings, such as tech stand-ups or scheduled meetings at 12:30 or 2 PM.

Meeting introduced new tech intern to team members and outlined roles within Thinkbyte's tech team: Yash Mori, Anupam, Vamsi as AI engineers; Shivani and Niharika on front-end with Flutterflow and Shopify; other interns from PDPU working on front-end.
GitHub Account Setup and Learning
New intern instructed to create GitHub account using Thinkbyte email, familiarize with Git, Docker, essential tools for version control, project management.
Documentation provided to assist with GitHub setup, usage.
Intern should share GitHub username with Yash for repository access and explore additional online resources to enhance understanding.
Assigning Tasks and Responsibilities
Intern will participate in tech delivery meetings on Mondays, Tuesdays, Fridays at 1:30 PM to discuss tasks, blockers, new findings.
Intern encouraged to seek assistance from team members or advisors if needed.
New intern will receive varied tasks, primarily in front-end development, before being assigned specific role after one month. Goal is to acclimate intern to team dynamics and project requirements.
Team Composition
Team includes members working on various technologies: React, Next.js, Flutterflow, Shopify, providing comprehensive coverage of both front-end and back-end development needs.
Need for effective collaboration among diverse team members with different expertise levels, ensuring projects benefit from full range of team capabilities.
Team composed of AI engineers, front-end developers, interns from PDPU, reflecting diverse skill set and backgrounds.
Collaboration with PDPU provides learning opportunities, resources for both students and company, fostering strong relationship and pipeline for new talent.
Continuous learning, skill development emphasized for team members, ensuring they stay updated with latest technologies, best practices.
Current Projects
Dementia care app completed, launched on Play Store, but additional developments, improvements ongoing, with focus on user feedback, enhancements.
Dementia care app includes small games to aid memory, developed by interns, providing engaging way to support users with dementia.
Need for ongoing development, improvements based on user feedback, specifically for dementia care app, ensuring app continues to meet user needs, expectations.
Team working on various projects, including dementia care app, lead generation project for client Bolt.
Lead generation project requires effective use of AI to identify best companies for client Bolt, necessitating skilled team members familiar with AI technologies.
Ongoing exploration of new projects, potential new platform being developed, allowing team to expand offerings and capabilities.
Dementia Care App Project
A dementia care app was launched on Play Store, developed by team members including Yash, Anupam, Shivani, and interns. It features games for cognitive stimulation.
Team seeks feedback from intern on app for improvements.
Intern encouraged to explore app on Play Store, suggest enhancements.
Lead Generation and Enrichment Project
Lead generation project underway, using AI to identify potential companies for clients like Bolt. Focus is on using AI for lead generation and enrichment.
Platform Project Development
Development of new platform project by Thinkbyte is underway. Project aims to create proprietary platform post-completion of other projects.
Technology and Tools
Some team members need to set up or transition to Linux for project requirements, which may involve additional training, resources.
Encourage use of Linux over Windows for project-related tasks, though initial use of Windows allowed until transition is feasible.
Emphasis on using GitHub, version control, Docker for efficient project management, collaboration, ensuring all team members can contribute effectively to codebase.
Encourage familiarity with necessary libraries, tools for project tasks, particularly those involved in front-end development, data scraping.
New members should set up GitHub accounts with company email addresses for seamless integration into company projects, ensuring proper access to private repositories.
Action Items
Yash Mori
Set up a Github account and share the username with Speaker 1 for repository access.
Organizes and communicates the setup of the Github account, project tasks, and team introductions.
Familiarize with Github and related libraries, explore scraping libraries for projects.
Speaker 2
Invite Yash Mori to tech stand-up meetings for team introductions.
Yash Mori needs to familiarize himself with all team members and set up his laptop for work.
Request Yash Mori's Github username for repository access.
Share a document with Yash Mori on setting up a Github account.
